name: Log Shattering / VC Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, log shattering is at least VC dimension.
proof: If a set of size $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$ is shattered, all of its $2^d$ subsets are shattered. Thus the shattering family has size at least $2^d$, and $\log_2|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|\geq d$.
